policy.identity_display_separation: Historical Place identity and reviewed geographic evidence belong here; runtime display anchors do not.
policy.no_guessing: Do not infer coordinates, subregions, or canonical identity from a Person name, modern nationality, or an unreviewed place-name string.
policy.precision_rule: Coordinate precision may be reviewed_point only when coordinates are reviewed and backed by source references; otherwise keep precision unknown.
policy.incremental_binding: Existing polity-place functions may keep place_id null until a canonical Place binding is historically reviewed.
